problem_type: Shared viewport measurement runs before its DOM owner is attached and misses visibility transitions
symptom: A cold reopened director shows the loaded character in the main viewport but its saved camera PiP stays blank; a newly added camera previews normally.
direct_cause: PipViewport child layout effect reads the parent hostRef before React attaches that host ref. It returns without a ResizeObserver and stable dependencies never retry. showPreview also does not participate in setup or cleanup.
class_root: The scissor rectangle lifetime must belong to a visible committed screen and its committed host, with all conditional DOM mount transitions represented.
affected_population: Cold mounting a saved scene with cameras
Initially hidden preview and later show

external_sources.purpose: Post-commit synchronization, dependency changes and unmount cleanup; checked through Context7.
Installed ReactDOM 18.3.1 commitLayoutEffects traverses child before parent, invokes child hook then attaches parent ref (local react-dom.development.js:24703,24727,23542).

invariants: A visible committed screen with a camera gets a measured rectangle even on first mount
Hidden, collapsed, camera-less and unmounted screens own no rectangle or observer
Resize updates the same rectangle without acquiring another renderer
generality_proof: All PiP mount, visibility, layout and camera transitions converge on one post-commit measurement effect. Its dependencies and cleanup own the observer and rectangle for both PipRenderer and AspectGuide.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Measure committed screen/host and own observer/rectangle for every visibility and layout transition.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: hostRef parent div and PipViewport child cold mount
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Parent DOM ref attachment follows child layout effects; post-commit measurement sees both refs without waiting on an unrelated camera change.
The showPreview dependency clears measurements on hide and registers the new screen when shown again, including initially hidden mounts.
Both remain dependencies of the same measurement effect; collapsed and camera-less states clear the rectangle.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: viewport measurement and PiP mask consumer
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Its own DOM measurement already uses post-commit useEffect keyed by inPov. Its mask consumes the shared rectangle and does not create an independent PiP rectangle.

recurrence.reason: Any saved camera scene can reach the cold mount ordering; any visibility transition can leave stale or missing measurements.
same_class_scan: Read DirectorViewport hostRef ownership and PipViewport useLayoutEffect/conditional return independently.
rg showCameraPreview/setPanelVisibility checked store defaults, reset and visibility action.
Read PipRenderer rectangle early-return and AspectGuide measurement/mask consumer; no renderer or pixel algorithm needs replacement.

prevention.invariant: Only a visible committed screen owns a measured scissor rectangle and observer.
prevention.failure_mode: Hidden, unmounted or missing camera/DOM leaves a null rectangle and no observer.
prevention.strategy: Synchronize measurements after the entire DOM commit and explicitly key setup/cleanup by showPreview, layout and selected camera.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace child-layout-phase host measurement and visibility-blind dependencies in place; no fallback polling or parallel renderer.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: React 18 commit ordering and ResizeObserver behave as designed. This is application ownership/timing, fixed using existing documented useEffect without runtime upgrade.

migration: No saved data changes; reopening existing scenes uses the corrected measurement lifecycle.
residual_risks: The Node component slice substitutes DOM commit scheduling/ResizeObserver; the same-build Electron screenshot-pixel journey supplies actual React, DOM and GPU evidence.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 不变量由 src/workbench/generationCanvas/nodes/director/panels/viewport/PipViewport.tsx 单点持有（即本合同的 prevention.enforcement_path / shared_boundaries）；上游其它入口只调用它、不各自重判。tests 是该层现有的类级与回归测试，改动这条不变量必先让它们红。
